description: Update a UCP checkout session. Send line_items to replace all lines (each line may name a variant_id), and/or fulfillment to set the delivery address (fulfillment.destination, which returns the shipping options) and choose one (fulfillment.selected_option_id, which adds shipping to the totals). Only allowed when status is 'incomplete'. Use ONLY for sessions created with ucp_create_checkout; for the standard flow use create_cart and select_shipping_option. Checkout guide: read the MCP resource trusteed://guides/checkout.

agent_key.description: Sandbox credential from `create_sandbox_key`. Use this when your client cannot set an `Authorization: Bearer` header.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code (e.g. USD). Optional: defaults to the checkout's currency.

fulfillment.description: Delivery. Send destination first, then selected_option_id (or both in one call).

destination.description: Delivery address. Sending it loads the shipping options for that destination; the response lists them in fulfillment.options.

country_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (e.g. US, ES)

selected_option_id.description: Id of one of fulfillment.options. Choosing it adds the shipping amount to the totals.

idempotency_key.description: REQUIRED for this write unless sent as the `Idempotency-Key` header or `params._meta["trusteed/idempotency-key"]`. 1-128 chars from [A-Za-z0-9._:/-]. Reuse the same value when retrying the same operation.

line_items.description: Replacement line items (replaces all lines). Omit to leave the lines as they are.

amount.description: Ignored: the catalogue price is used and returned per line. Any non-negative integer is accepted.

title.description: Ignored: the catalogue title is used. Any non-empty string is accepted.

variant_id.description: Variant (size/colour) id as listed by get_product_details. Required when the product has more than one variant; the price and stock of THAT variant apply.

meta.description: UCP request metadata. meta['ucp-agent'].profile = URL of the platform profile; it must be an https URL without credentials (at most 2048 characters).

name: ucp_update_checkout

expires_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC instant at which this checkout SESSION stops being usable. It is not a stock reservation and not a price guarantee.

expires_in_seconds.description: Whole seconds left on this checkout SESSION at response time (0 when already past). It is not a stock reservation and not a price guarantee.

next_action.description: Only when a person must approve or pay: `url`, `kind`, `retry`.

next_step.description: Next-action code, not a tool name: provide_shipping_destination, refresh_shipping_rates, choose_shipping_option, preview_ucp_checkout, review_not_available_in_ucp.

payment_options.description: When present, ask the person which option they want; never choose for them.
